instruction: Navigate to the Ticketek help center page.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent started on premier.ticketek.com.au which showed a security block. Tried Google search (SSL error). Eventually navigated to help.ticketek.com.au/hc/en-us, passed Cloudflare CAPTCHA, found FAQ categories, and clicked Ticket Delivery section. Failed because final URL did not match expected pattern.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome address bar, enter URLs, handle Cloudflare CAPTCHA, browse help pages, click category links
metadata.failure_analysis: Original task failed because the URL pattern 'Ticket-Delivery-FAQs' did not match the actual URL 'categories/360000153687-Ticket-Delivery'. The agent found the right content but the URL structure was different than expected.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to just reaching the help center, which the model demonstrated it can do despite the initial security block on premier.ticketek.com.au
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from the blocked premier.ticketek.com.au to the help center at help.ticketek.com.au. Evaluator checks the active tab URL matches the help center domain using regex pattern matching.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL, which is the right state to verify a navigation task.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict (via get_rule for type='rule') and accesses rules['expected'] to get regex patterns — parameter handling is correct.
Regex pattern 'help\.ticketek\.com\.au' semantically matches the Ticketek help center domain, fully verifying the instruction 'Navigate to the Ticketek help center page'.
Single-step instruction with single verification check — complete coverage of all requirements.
No UI dialog state dependency; URL is stable after navigation, so no postconfig needed.
